# Skills that publish to the Tessl registry WITH their eval scenarios.
#
# Read by .github/workflows/tessl-publish.yml. Every publish of a skill named here
# uploads its evals/ and starts a scored eval run (scenarios x 2 solves), which
# spends the org's Tessl credit allowance. Every other skill publishes with
# --skip-evals, which caps its registry Score at 0.8 x Quality.
#
# A skill stays on this list once its evals are on the registry: a later version
# published without them would drop back under that cap. One skill name per line,
# matching its directory under plugins/<plugin>/skills/.

# Evals reached the registry on 2026-08-17. pytest-asyncio-patterns,
# state-transition-test-design and async-ordering-tests were republished without
# them on 2026-10-11; their next version restores them.
